name: Hasty Pudding Theatricals
watch: The Jeffrey Epstein Virgin Islands Foundation and Gratitude America gave the Hasty Pudding Institute of 1770, the umbrella group for Hasty Pudding Theatricals, at least $375,000: $75,000 in 2013 and $50,000 a year from 2014 to 2019. watch: The donors' Nazi pasts came out in early 2024. The council renamed the house from Edith-Russ-Haus on 24 February 2025.
why_flagged: The donors' Nazi pasts came out in early 2024. The council renamed the house from Edith-Russ-Haus on 24 February 2025.

name: Institut du monde arabe
watch: Jack Lang led the Institut du monde arabe from 2013. He is named 673 times in the DOJ files released on 30 January 2026, and emails show he travelled in Epstein's jet and car.
why_flagged: The French foreign ministry funds over half its income; the founding Arab states stopped paying their share. The TotalEnergies Foundation is its major sponsor, with exhibitions in 2023 to 2025.
records_note: It posts activity reports for 2014 to 2025 (with gaps) and names patrons for 2026, but no accounts or board; only the president is named.
